eligible_scope: Official university, academy, public archive, learned society, professional body, or public research-funding body page maintained for the exact named person.
identity_requirement: Exact-person identity must be explicit on the page or document.
date_requirement: Full day-month-year must be explicit and tied to birth or life dates.
provenance_requirement: Official institutional domain or authenticated official publication. Local raw capture is preferred; a documented access-block archive exception is allowed only after manual live review.
independence_rule: Language versions and pages in the same institution or content family count as one source group.

category_label: Primary member CV on official academy or institution platform
eligible_scope: CV clearly belonging to the exact person and hosted under an official member or person namespace.
identity_requirement: CV must identify the exact person.
date_requirement: Full birth date must be explicitly stated.
provenance_requirement: Official platform and stable person namespace; mirrored copies inherit the issuer group and require origin verification.
independence_rule: A mirrored copy is not independent from the issuing institution or original CV.

eligible_scope: Curated named-person biography from a reputable foundation, prize body, encyclopedia, scholarly reference, or specialist biographical database.
date_requirement: Full birth date must be explicitly stated.
independence_rule: Requires a second independent Tier B source group or one Tier A source.

category_label: Official-branded primary document on an external mirror
eligible_scope: Document visibly issued by an official institution but hosted on another trusted platform.
identity_requirement: Exact person and issuer must both be explicit.
date_requirement: Full birth date must be explicitly stated.
provenance_requirement: Issuer, origin, and document integrity must be verified.
independence_rule: Counts in the issuer independence group, never as a new mirror-host group.

category_label: Copied, locator, authority, or non-independent content
eligible_scope: Pages whose date text is copied from Wikipedia or DBpedia, authority-only locators, search results, or other non-independent content.
date_requirement: Date text may be present but is not counted as independent evidence.
provenance_requirement: Preserve as locator or provenance only.
independence_rule: Never creates a new evidence group.
